1124.title: The Prestige
1124.overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

10404.title: Raise the Red Lantern
10404.overview: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

66148.title: The Late Mathias Pascal
66148.overview: Mathias Pascal, only son of a once-rich family, marries beautiful Romalinda, who has a terrible mother-in-law. She controls her daughter, and soon his home life becomes a nightmare. His only moments of lights are his mother and baby, but both die on the same day. Shocked, he leaves his hometown and goes to Monte Carlo, where he wins a fortune at the casino. Returning home, he reads his own obituary in a paper. They have found a corpse in a creek and connected it with his disappearance. Mathias, noticing that he is now free from all ties to his old life, decides to start a new one.

67300.title: Castle Orgies
67300.overview: A young girl who has been made a maidservant in the harem of the Tokugawa shogun. She is entrusted with the role of the mistress's maid and gradually grows up to be a woman.

701668.title: Blood on Snow
701668.overview: A hit man falls for his client's wife, who happens to be the target of the assassin's latest assignment.

764516.title: Fogaréu
764516.overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

832676.title: Wind
832676.overview: In a time after devastating wars, plagues, and natural disasters, the social order has collapsed, and new moral systems, beliefs, and forms of survival emerge. The story follows Ivan Morozov, who leaves his wife Katya to search for necessities, and meets Sergei Volkov, a mysterious companion. Together, they travel through haunting landscapes filled with forgotten villages, strange rituals, and mythological echoes, culminating in a profound and painful choice.

862756.title: Truck Driver
862756.overview: A hybrid film that paints a collective portrait of people who share a strange dimension of time within the silence of the asphalt wilderness – at motels, on the side of the road, and in tire shops, savoring the pure joy of the present moment while longing for loved ones far away.

934372.title: Any Other Night
934372.overview: On the night of a crippling transit strike in Berlin, two strangers are thrown together while their personal lives fall apart. After Maggie’s every possession is packed into Sam’s taxi, they discover a spark. But as the meter ticks – and the night gets weirder – it dawns that timing might be everything.

945956.title: I Am Legend 2
945956.overview: A sequel to the 2007 film. Plot TBA.

982116.title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
982116.overview: Follows the story of the groundbreaking Texas-based art-punk band founded by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.
982116.trailerName: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt TEASER
982116.original_title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt

991332.title: Kanaval
991332.overview: In the mid-1970s, Rico, a 9-year-old Haitian boy, was brutally torn from his native land  along with Erzulie, his mother, to a strange planet called Canada. Since their arrival, a  distance seems to have grown between mother and son. To regain the love of his mother, Rico will have to understand this New World populated by individuals with strange habits  and customs. Fortunately for him, he can count on Kana, his imaginary friend who comes  straight out of Haitian mythology.

999140.title: Dandelion's Odyssey
999140.overview: Two dandelion balls are the only survivors of a series of nuclear explosions that are destroying the Earth. At the end of their odyssey, they will find a new soil for the survival of their species.

1088548.title: Bitter Christmas
1088548.overview: Elsa is an advertising director whose mother dies during a long December holiday. She works non-stop and, without realizing, doesn’t give herself time to mourn her mother’s absence. After a crisis, Elsa decides to travel to the island of Lanzarote accompanied by her friend Patricia, who also needs to get away from the city. The story of these characters runs parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

1096228.title: Musk
1096228.overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

1101412.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
1101412.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

1146148.title: Sorry, Charlie
1146148.overview: A remote helpline volunteer is targeted by "The Gentleman," a stranger who lures women from their homes with a recording of a crying baby.

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads
Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

1163940.title: Crocodile Tears
1163940.overview: An overbearing mother who lives with her son in a secluded crocodile farm spirals out of control when her son sees the outside world and falls for a girl for the first time.

1176932.title: A Girl Named Willow
1176932.overview: What could Willow do with an entire forest? That's exactly what she asks herself when she inherits this forest from her aunt Alwina. That's not all, though - Alwina has also left her a small, crooked cabin and, most importantly, her witchcraft. But the question remains: Will Willow even accept this unexpected inheritance, with all the consequences it entails?

1206628.title: The Third Parent
1206628.overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

1217892.title: Flamin­go Flamenco
1217892.overview: The Fuente de Piedra lagoon in Spain is home to one of the largest flocks of flamingos in Europe. Once a year, the adolescent birds perform a dance that looks like... flamenco! But when the flock is attacked by hateful podencos (wild dogs) our heroine Rosie, a fun, dance crazy flamingo, loses her beloved sister and the flamenco is cancelled henceforth. She grows up a shadow of her former self, robbed of her sisters love and the joy of dance. One day she meets Carlos, an exuberant lizard, who encourages her to dance once more - rekindling her inner flame. Over time, she transforms back into her old confident self, before leading her flock to face down the podencos and dance once more.

1249508.title: Grizzly Night
1249508.overview: On August 12, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: that same night, nine miles apart, there were not one—but two—fatal grizzly bear attacks.

1263012.title: Dead Man's Wire
1263012.overview: In 1977, former real estate developer Tony Kiritsis puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.

1265316.title: The Tale of Tsar Saltan
1265316.overview: One dark winter evening, the young tsar Saltan was lucky enough to find himself a tsarina from a simple Russian family. He was so impressed by the speech of the young charmer that he married her the same evening, and took her two sisters with him to the palace as servants. However, the treacherous girls do not share the happiness of their luckier sister and begin to plot. Saltan leaves for a long military campaign, during which the young queen gives birth to his son. The evil sisters write a dispatch to the tsar, where they brazenly lie about the child: they say, the queen gave birth to someone unknown, "neither a son nor a daughter." Saltan is upset, but orders to wait until his return. The sisters substitute the letter, and as a result, the girl and her son are sealed in a wooden barrel and thrown into the ocean in the best sadistic traditions.

1308388.title: Hunting Matthew Nichols
1308388.overview: Twenty-three years after her brother mysteriously disappeared, a documentary filmmaker sets out to solve his missing person's case. But when a disturbing piece of evidence is revealed, she comes to believe that her brother might still be alive.

1322532.title: Cek Khodam
1322532.overview: Nowadays, people are more afraid of empty wallets, late payments, and the end of the month than ghosts. Ghosts are even used as entertainment through the content Cek Khodam (Hodgkin's Check) created by three friends, Sakti, Wira, and Bima. Unbeknownst to them, their actions have drastically reduced the Human Fear Score (AKM). To restore the dignity of the supernatural world and raise the human fear score, the Commander of the Khodam is tasked with descending directly into the human world. However, the mission does not go according to plan. The harder the khodam try to scare humans, the more chaos they create.
1322532.trailerName: KHODAM CHECK - OFFICIAL TRAILER | JULY 16, 2026 IN THEATERS

1339876.title: Mardaani 3
1339876.overview: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.

1351908.title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
1351908.overview: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.
1351908.trailerName: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata | The Unseen Heroes | Trailer | Kangana Ranaut | In Cinemas 12th June

1354596.title: And
1354596.overview: The friendship between two boys end when one finally admits they need to part ways.

1363620.title: The Undertaker 2: Afterlife
1363620.overview: Following the passing of Baikaow and Sak, life in the village slowly returns to normal. This calm is disrupted when Grandma Joy is suddenly struck by lightning and miraculously revives.
1363620.trailerName: สัปเหร่อ 2 - Official Trailer

1376484.title: Roid
1376484.overview: A solitary middle aged man marries a madwoman and builds a house on a vacant plot of land far from the village. However, his wife’s madness becomes a calamity in his tranquil life.

1396772.title: The Art of Seducing God
1396772.overview: Hikmah might be considered a disobedient child to her late mother, but her mother wasn't always kind to Hikmah either. Yet now, her late mother appears in his dream, pleading with Hikmah to save her from the torment of the grave. Caught in the turmoil of his faith, Hikmah embarks on a journey to uncover the true wisdom in his life—seeking ways to persuade God to save her mother and himself.
1396772.trailerName: The Art of Wooing God Official Final Trailer

1423780.title: Ветер в голове
1423780.overview: A hockey player who traded friendships for a career in the United States returns home with an incurable disease. He has little time left to atone for his former friends and find peace of mind before the medication that sustains his fight against death runs out. However, a conflict with local gangsters disrupts his plans.

1429348.title: The Stranger
1429348.overview: Algiers, 1938. Meursault, a quiet and unassuming employee in his early thirties, attends his mother's funeral without shedding a tear. The next day, he begins a casual affair with Marie, a work colleague. He quickly slips back into his usual routine.
1429348.trailerName: The Stranger | Official Trailer | In Select Theaters April 3

1430372.title: Make Sense
1430372.overview: Michelin-star-winning master chef Michael Bringalow adds an autumnal soup to his menu.

1430820.title: At Work
1430820.overview: A successful photographer gives up everything to devote himself to writing and discovers poverty.

1438436.title: Adieu L'Amour
1438436.overview: Henri has become a real jerk. It’s been two years since his relationship with Émilie ended. Everyone has moved on. Not him. His job as a photographer no longer interests him, and human relationships even less. Bitter and increasingly alone. Until the day a man breaks into his home.

1442084.title: Seppuku: The Sun Goes Down
1442084.overview: Kakizaki Yuji’s period film is not like the jidaigeki films we are used to. While it deals with themes of seppuku, duty, and loyalty to one’s masters and the shogun, we see very little in terms of action. Instead, the film focuses on the inner thoughts and struggles of the protagonist—who is ordered to perform a ritual suicide—his wife, and their entire household, all leading up to the final moment.

1457188.title: Pompei: Below the Clouds
1457188.overview: Naples faces dual volcanic threats from Vesuvius and Campi Flegrei. Amid increasing tremors, archaeologists work as residents live anxiously, haunted by Pompeii's fate while emergency services strain.

1475044.title: Forget-me-not
1475044.overview: Dean Carter's mind unravels while deciphering the mystery behind the disappearance of his fiancé.

1484708.title: Sugar Beach
1484708.overview: A grief-stricken valedictorian spirals into a consuming throuple in the wake of her twin brother's death, and must confront the past she's been outrunning before it swallows her whole.

1495716.title: App the Horror
1495716.overview: When the app is launched, a ghost appears. Developed by four young adults, the app becomes the centerpiece of a livestream where they venture into a supposedly haunted mountain to prove its authenticity—only to meet a grim fate.

1511780.title: Woman Unknown
1511780.overview: Marie, a former housekeeper, plans an extravagant dinner party for her engagement to the household's patriarch. As preparations unfold, hidden aspects of her past begin to surface, threatening to disrupt the celebration.

1523428.title: Кто-то должен умереть
1523428.overview: When Yulya learns of her beloved husband's betrayal, she decides to poison both him and his mistress. Now, to get the antidote, the cheaters must prove that they truly love each other, otherwise death is inevitable.

1537700.title: Shooting Stars (They Flew in the Firmament, Love)
1537700.overview: He escaped that night without knowing that Valeria would be there... Luca had no idea that his life would change forever.

1541732.title: The Belt
1541732.overview: A young woman's night unravels into chaos after she accidentally locks herself into a chastity belt during a house party and loses the key.

1542884.title: 4 Idiots
1542884.overview: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys.

1548004.title: The Summer I Turned Pretty: The Movie
1548004.overview: A continuation of the events following the end of the TV series 'The Summer I Turned Pretty."

1548708.title: Sakamoto Days
1548708.overview: After getting married and having a daughter, a retired legendary hitman must protect his family when his past catches up to him.
1548708.trailerName: 映画『SAKAMOTO DAYS』予告　【2026.4.29（水・祝）公開】

1550500.title: The Boom Killer
1550500.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.

1564324.title: Adam's Eight
1564324.overview: Adam's Eight tells the remarkable true story of Karl Adam — a visionary rowing coach who, in 1950s Germany, brought together a group of underdogs and turned them into champions. Within just three years, his team defied all odds and won Olympic gold in Rome in 1960.

1567460.title: Round 13
1567460.overview: Kamel, a former boxing champion, swapped fame for a peaceful life with his beloved wife, Samia, and their son, Sabri. But when a simple accident reveals Sabri has a bone tumour, their world is shaken. As their son bravely fights for his life, Kamel and Samia are pushed to their emotional limits. Sabri’s courage inspires, Samia’s hope endures, and Kamel, driven by love and pain, must face his deepest fears. After a painful separation, the family reunites for one final round: a fight not in the ring, but for love, strength, and survival.

1572196.title: Perilous Passage: Birth in America
1572196.overview: A look at the impact of an already very precarious maternal health state in the U.S. post-rescinding of Roe v. Wade, via the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, reversing rights that women have been working so hard to fight for, and that will actually have a deep impact that we can't even see just yet in terms of the numbers of mortality and trauma as a result of those very draconian policies.

1572644.title: Double Kill
1572644.overview: Twin assassins take on a night of violent contracts until betrayal turns their mission into a fight for survival, forcing sister against sister in a relentless clash of blood, loyalty, and revenge.

1590884.title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
1590884.overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.
1590884.trailerName: NO PARADISE IF YOU ARE KILLED BY A WOMAN | Official Teaser Trailer | Venice 2026

1591972.title: Blood Moon Rite 8
1591972.overview: In an abandoned amusement park, a shoestring budget horror film is rolling. The crew features a "washed‐up yet unwavering" director, a leading couple whose onscreen romance has bled into real life, and a hot‐tempered makeup artist. The true nightmare begins when the director performs a "Blood Moon Ritual" meant to force genuine terror from his actors, no acting, only real fear and real tears.

1592548.title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
1592548.overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.
1592548.original_title: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第5話

1593380.title: Ninja Wars - BlackFox vs Shogun's Ninja
1593380.overview: Rikka Isurugi (Chihiro Yamamoto), head of the Fox Clan, is investigating the "White Lotus," a mysterious cult suspected of plotting a rebellion against the Shogunate. During her mission, she encounters Okyo (Kanon Miyahara), a Fuma Ninja dispatched by the Shogun. Their paths converge as they face a formidable common enemy: the Iga Ninja clan, led by Hattori Hanzo (Kane Kosugi), who harbors a deep vengeance against the Tokugawa family. A three-way conflict between the Fox Clan, Fuma Ninja, and Iga Ninja is about to begin.
1593380.trailerName: NINJA WARS 〜BLACKFOX VS SHOGUN'S NINJA〜 | Sneak Peek (Members Premiere 3/29)

1594276.title: Kamen Rider Eins with Girls Remix
1594276.overview: All the incidents occuring around the Girls Remix up to this point were part of Sumire Kurono's plan to create the ultimate Kamen Rider. Now that plan is moving into its final phase. Sumire kidnapes Nayuta Mikazuki again. After performing her final surgery, "Kamen Rider Eins" is finally born. Will the Girls Remix be able to get Nayuta back? And what will become of Nayuta, who has become Kamen Rider Eins?
1594276.trailerName: 【予告】仮面ライダーアインズ　ｗｉｔｈガールズリミックス（３０秒）

1596260.title: Night Nurse
1596260.overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

1596324.title: The Best Summer
1596324.overview: Immersive POV camera footage reveals electric performances, candid interviews, and intimate backstage life with the Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Foo Fighters, Pavement, Rancid, Beck, The Amps, and Bikini Kill — an all-access view inside an era-defining moment in music.

1598500.title: Sun in Lidia
1598500.overview: Lidia goes with her mother, Gina, to the beach house where they used to vacation during her childhood. What should have been an opportunity to relax by the sea, begins to reveal unresolved issues in their relationship.

1613284.title: The Age Of Goodbyes
1613284.overview: Set in Malaysia, the film follows a young woman named Du Li An who falls in love with a man named Lin Sang in 1969 before he mysteriously disappears. Years later, after marrying a gangster and becoming stepmother to a teenage girl, Du Li An encounters a man who looks exactly like her vanished lover. The decade-spanning narrative blends elements of romance, mystery and coming-of-age storytelling.

1616740.title: Mors
1616740.overview: Alone in a crumbling house, a failed filmmaker’s quiet night takes a terrifying turn after a knock at the door forces her to confront everything she tried to forget.

1616868.title: Einar Schleef - No Germany Did I Find
1616868.overview: With his monumental productions, Einar Schleef pushed theatre to the outer reaches, confounded expectations in East and West alike, grappled with GDR origins and the BRD present. A universal artist emerges from the archive: “I’m not human, I’m dynamite”.
1616868.original_title: Einar Schleef - Ich habe kein Deutschland gefunden

1620452.title: Das Gewicht der Welt
1620452.overview: Models, calculations, samples: the facts about climate change are on the table, but politicians refuse to acknowledge them. Faced with this dilemma, three scientists decide to leave the laboratory and become activists. Maria, Sebastian, and Nana use their knowledge to maintain integrity between emotion and reason.

1622180.title: Deep Hallows - A Brazilian Gothic Fable
1622180.overview: The small town of Furnas Fundas hides a secret far older than its pastures, forests, or the people who live there. During a heated election marred by scandals, Bartira, known merely as the town drunk, unexpectedly finds herself at the center of it all. It’s up to her to face a dark force that has returned to turn the town into a true bloodbath.
1622180.original_title: Furnas Fundas: Uma Fábula Gótica Brasileira

1622436.title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
1622436.overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

1636196.title: I Don't Love You Anymore
1636196.overview: A man is found floating lifeless in a suburban couple’s pool, and nothing about the story adds up. In separate police interrogations, their conflicting accounts twist and fracture, revealing a Rashomon-like web of deceit, buried desire, and long-denied truths. As the night of the shooting replays from shifting perspectives, a tale of love, loyalty, and betrayal slowly surfaces — darker and more disturbing than anyone wants to admit.

1641572.title: Compact Disc
1641572.overview: After years of silence, the director and his friends return to fragments of a youth shaped by imprisonment, scars and dreams. Lingering with fading images and fragile memories, they together build a space where unspeakable collective traumas can exist and be held.

1645668.title: A Butler's Job
1645668.overview: A devoted butler tries to save his detective master from a mysterious vampiric kidnapping.

1646116.title: Raptor Attack
1646116.overview: Jevan moves her family into her late mother's home, only to discover her mother, Iris, a genetic scientist, created a deadly raptor that's now on the loose. As the creature hunts them, Jevan and her family must fight to survive and find a way to stop the ultimate predator.

1647332.title: Running Man: Light & Shadow
1647332.overview: In Tree City, Metronome works in secret to keep all things in balance. Adel, its charismatic director, hires the former champions of the Running Man competition as agents. Among them is Adel’s protégé, Lema. One day the Running Men inexplicably begin committing crimes throughout the city. Adel recognizes the threat and mobilizes Metronome to rise from the darkness to face them. Lema, shocked by the Running Men’s sudden transformation, decides to pursue her own investigation in order to prevent a devastating war…

1649764.title: The Devil's Due
1649764.overview: For inquisitor Jude Price, sobriety meant leaving his demons behind. But when a trail of strange disappearances leads back to his former local, he realises they've been awaiting his return.

1650276.title: Holly
1650276.overview: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection and  is greeted with an entity that craves her innocence.

1650660.title: A Quiet House
1650660.overview: SHE’S ALWAYS BEEN AN OLD SOUL Sian and Lewis, are a married couple spend who their days attempting to reach out to their daughter, Hope. Sian brings meals to their room whilst Lewis waits and listens. However, the couple are stuck in a loop that conceals reality. The evening brings warmth and comfort, whilst the harsh morning light reveals the truth of what lies beyond Hope’s door.

1652836.title: Super Duperr
1652836.overview: When a deceitful agent sells the same house twice, a modern couple and a village family must somehow share a roof and their very different worlds.
1652836.trailerName: Super Duperr | सुपर डुपर | Trailer | Lalit Prabhakar, Vidula Chougule, Nirrmite Saawaant | 3 April

1660580.title: KARMA
1660580.overview: Three friends reunite after three years. They decide to challenge their fate through an absurd plan. Following a series of rash decisions, their journey turns into a comical mix of drama and absurdity. Each character faces inevitable consequences, discovering that fate cannot be manipulated without confronting the law of karma.

1661156.title: Giro poder o filme 4 o medalhão do poder o filme

1671716.title: Maxo: Forbidden Ritual
1671716.overview: Crushed by extreme poverty and haunted by the fear of losing another child after a miscarriage, the lives of Phú and his pregnant wife Thảo spiral further into darkness when Phú’s mother, Mrs. Thuận, dies because the family cannot afford her medical treatment. In desperation, Thảo follows the advice of Mrs. Tánh—a neighbor who performs spiritual rituals—and summons a wandering spirit to become a household ghost, believing it will protect their home and unborn child. But when the entity hidden within the corner of the house begins to demand its debt, Thảo realizes in horror that the thing she invited in to save her family is, in fact, a nightmare with no escape.
1671716.trailerName: MA XÓ - MAIN TRAILER | KHỞI CHIẾU: 05.06.2026

1675748.title: Father, Son and the Price of Resistance
1675748.overview: The father fought against the dictatorship in East Germany using his typewriter. His son took active measures. Two forms of resistance and an abyss of silence. Götz Schauder uses video messages to build a bridge between the two men. A painful struggle for the truth begins.
1675748.original_title: Vater, Sohn und der Preis des Widerstands

1679012.title: The School Show
1679012.overview: Socialist Croatia, sometime during the mid-1980s. During a play at a local elementary school, one of the contestants notices that an audience member is acting very suspicously, which piques her curiosity.

1684644.title: EXOTIC
1684644.overview: It’s hard to dislike Mila; at 30, she carries her insecurities close, overanalyses everything, and is much kinder to others than to herself. When her friend cancels their trip at the last minute, Mila swallows her fear and sets off alone for a pole dance camp. Among sculpted dancers, scant costumes, and sky-high platforms, she feels awkward, alien, and instantly out of place.

1685284.title: СМП-340
1685284.overview: Working with the archive, I observe how documentary memory conflicts with personal memory—this sense of displacement and substitution creates a complex system of distortions, reminiscent of a dream. I am fascinated by how layers of memory intertwine, erase each other, rewrite, and form new meanings.

1686692.title: Distance to Independance
1686692.overview: It's the late 1980s and the once seemingly undying Soviet Union is beginning to show signs of collapse, leaving thousands of members of the Ukrainian diaspora in the US and Canada with a chance of returning to the home they have always dreamed of living in. Afraid for their lives, but fueled by patriotism, thousands of them venture to Europe in order to provide the support to their friends relatives and their countrymen through times of crisis and violent protests, culminating in the last 99 days of the USSR and the birth of an independant Ukrainian nation.

1687076.title: Sea Legs
1687076.overview: The revelation of a late father's second family forces his grieving daughter to acknowledge the skeletons in her own closet.

1688292.title: NIGHT CLONES: SO MANY DAYS
1688292.overview: In this sequel to DONOVAN 17: THE WEEKEND WARS, after the clones, created by the Alien Surf Dude, questioned the purposes given to them, they decided to return to space, however, with The Brilliant Brick still lost in space, the few clones left must wait, uncertain whether to stay on Earth or go to space... These clones are the night clones... but are they the right clones?

1688804.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
1688804.overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

1690340.title: The Columbus Coroner
1690340.overview: In an effort to go viral, a struggling true crime YouTuber decides to hunt down an infamous serial killer.

1691300.title: Lastri: Arwah Kembang Desa
1691300.overview: Atmi is terrorized by the spirit of Lastri, a woman who committed suicide 30 years ago due to slander and cruel treatment from her village. Now, Lastri has returned to seek revenge, especially on Atmi and those who destroyed her life.

1696804.title: Falling to Heaven

1709988.title: Les Audacieux.ses
1709988.overview: François, Renée, Gisèle, Sylvain. These seniors do not have much in common, but their lives have been shaped by episodes of abandonment, rejection, or fear. Some still live in invisibility, afraid of how others will look at them. Loneliness weighs heavily. For others, living with HIV has worn down their bodies, and old age arrives more quickly. Then there is a hope: that of a house in Lyon where they will finally be able to be themselves. A place where it will be possible to grow old without ever having to hide again. There is that family we choose for ourselves. The feeling that a new chapter is opening—the last one—filled with promise, and with the boldness of all those first times we finally allow ourselves, so late in life. But when it comes to becoming visible, the fears accumulated over a lifetime are never far away. And they come to pull our courageous dreamers back from their dream: should they take the leap?
